targetingPolicies.name: Adult customers only
targetingPolicies.description: Contractual minimum age for any commercial offer.

targetingPolicies.name: Credit check passed
targetingPolicies.description: Required before any offer that creates a new credit agreement.

targetingPolicies.name: Fibre available at address
targetingPolicies.description: Do not offer full fibre where the network has not been built.

targetingPolicies.name: Not already on 5G unlimited
targetingPolicies.description: Suppress the offer for customers who already hold it.

targetingPolicies.name: Consistently near allowance
targetingPolicies.description: Only offer a data boost where usage justifies it.

targetingPolicies.name: Contract ends within 90 days
targetingPolicies.description: Retention offers are only relevant near contract end.

targetingPolicies.name: PAC code requested
targetingPolicies.description: Winback only applies to customers who signalled intent to leave.

targetingPolicies.name: Affordability — upgrade spend
targetingPolicies.description: Do not upsell customers whose bill is already a high share of estimated income.

targetingPolicies.name: Affordability — retention
targetingPolicies.description: A retention offer must reduce, not increase, the customer bill.

targetingPolicies.name: Insurance suitability
targetingPolicies.description: FCA — do not offer insurance where the device value is below the total premium.

targetingPolicies.name: Usage projection available
targetingPolicies.description: Service messages need at least 3 months of usage history.

frequencyPolicies.name: Global outbound cap
frequencyPolicies.description: No more than 3 commercial contacts per customer per week across all channels.

frequencyPolicies.name: SMS daily cap
frequencyPolicies.description: At most one commercial SMS per day.

frequencyPolicies.name: Email weekly cap
frequencyPolicies.description: At most two marketing emails per week.

frequencyPolicies.name: Winback cooldown
frequencyPolicies.description: After a declined winback offer, suppress retention contact for 30 days.

frequencyPolicies.name: Service messages exempt
frequencyPolicies.description: Bill shock and account health alerts are not commercial and bypass frequency caps.

boosts.name: Q4 retention push
boosts.reason: Churn is 2.1pp above plan; board-approved retention emphasis through year end.

boosts.name: 5G flagship boost
boosts.reason: Strategic priority to migrate the base onto 5G ahead of the 3G sunset.

boosts.name: Service messages priority
boosts.reason: Duty-of-care messages must outrank commercial offers in arbitration.

boosts.name: Legacy suppression
boosts.reason: Retired offer; suppress in case any flow still references it.

connectors.name: Billing ledger
connectors.description: Current balance, arrears and rolling spend, pre-computed nightly and served from the online store.

connectors.name: Network usage
connectors.description: Rolling 30-day data, voice and roaming usage from the mediation platform.

connectors.name: Consent registry
connectors.description: Marketing and profiling consent of record. Defaults closed on failure, because assuming consent is the one mistake with a regulator attached.

connectors.name: Credit bureau
connectors.description: Full bureau file. Configured, and deliberately not wired into any live flow: at 180ms it cannot be called synchronously inside a 50ms budget, and the compiler says so rather than letting it fail in production.

connectors.name: Device catalogue
connectors.description: Handset stock and lead times. Not yet activated pending contract sign-off.
